newsitem.title: ITALY: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare di Sondrio ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare di Sondrio ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European ratings agency, said it has affirmed the long and short-term ratings of Italy's Banca Popolare di Sondrio at A and A1 respectively.
It said in a statement received in Milan that the Individual and Legal ratings are also unchanged at B and 4.

"While protecting its business in its home province, where the bank enjoys a 42 percent share of the customer deposit market, Sondrio has grown into a regional bank, expanding mainly in the Valtellina Valley but also in other provinces of Lombardy and in Rome," IBCA said.
IBCA said that in 1996 economic difficulties led to a deterioration in the bank's asset quality, and to higher loan loss provisions But overall operating profit for 1996 was stable compared to 1995.

"Although Sondrio's asset quality remains considerably better than its Italian peers, some further deterioration is expected, and is therefore likely to continue to require additional loan loss provisions.
"Sondrio's funding base and liquidity remains strong and, with an end-1996 EU total capital ratio of 11.93 percent, the bank is adequately capitalised," IBCA added.
